text:
Situation: Clonazepam 1 mg tablets remain in shortage at Corvale General with 246 tablets on hand and 7.9 tablets used per day, providing 31.3 days of supply. The FDA shortage posting lists six manufacturers: Accord Healthcare Inc., Aurobindo Pharma USA, Cheplapharm Arzneimittel GmbH, Prinston Pharmaceutical Inc., Rubicon Research Private Limited, and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the clonazepam tablet shortage on 2023-03-10 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21. A label for Northstar Rx LLC names Rubicon Research Limited (FEI 3008252295) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1195651 at that plant ended 2023-01-27 and was classified VAI with the classification letter dated 2023-03-14. An earlier FDA inspection 828916 at the same plant in 2013 was also classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one month. Five potential suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no plant we could place. No clinical changes are proposed; any therapeutic adjustments are for the treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC (option 1) pending P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC (option 2) pending P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. (option 3) pending P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (option 4) pending P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with AvPAK (option 5) pending P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement while awaiting resolution of the FDA-listed manufacturer shortage.
